name: Monster High
description: Based on the Monster High franchise, Clawdeen Wolf arrives at Monster High with a dark secret. With the help of her friends Draculaura and Frankie Stein, she is able to embrace her true monster heart and save the school from total destruction.

videos.title: Food Fight
videos.overview: Draculaura practices witchcraft, and Clawdeen and Frankie must help her subdue the tater tot she brought to life!

videos.title: Unfinished Brain-ness
videos.overview: Frankie, "cursed" from their brain's past life, gets help from Clawdeen and Draculaura to break it.

videos.title: The Monstering
videos.overview: On her birthday, monster expert Clawdeen receives her mother's necklace from her father. It guides her to a hidden school called Monster High.

videos.title: Case of the Moondays
videos.overview: To evade monster hunters, Clawdeen must embrace her human side to save herself and Cleo.

videos.title: Portrait of a Monster
videos.overview: Frankie's picture day panic causes them to ZAP the school camera into a soul-sucking menace.

videos.title: Witch Hitch
videos.overview: Toralei and Lagoona threaten to expose Draculaura as a witch, sabotaging her campaign to be Head Fearleader.

videos.title: Part of the Pack
videos.overview: Clawdeen's friendship with Frankie and Draculaura is tested when she's invited to join Monster High's werewolf pack.

videos.title: That Thing You Deuce
videos.overview: Deuce overworks himself to win a fundraiser, accidentally turning other students into rock candy treats.

videos.title: Werewolf Weekend
videos.overview: Clawdeen opens up to her dad and learns they have a lot in common, while Cleo seeks followers in the human world.

videos.title: Paw-zzle Pieces
videos.overview: To discover the cause of her mother's disappearance, Clawdeen opens a portal in the catacombs and releases her brother Clawd.

videos.title: Nightmare Nightmore
videos.overview: Draculaura is set on hosting the perfect holiday party. But someone unexpected shows up and things don't go as planned, she struggles to cope with unmet expectations and sharing the spotlight.

videos.title: Out of Step
videos.overview: Afraid to be embarrassed at a dance-off, Draculaura gives her partner, Clawd, enchanted dancing shoes.

videos.title: Pyramid Scheme
videos.overview: Cleo wants the lead role for the school play and raids her family's ancient tomb for a perfect, superior costume.

videos.title: What's Up, Watzie?
videos.overview: Frankie doesn't want Watzie to leave for dragon migration, so they amp up the fun to try to convince him to stay.

videos.title: So Familiar
videos.overview: Draculaura must discover her familiar to open a Witchcraft Codex and hone her powers.

videos.title: Crushed
videos.overview: Frankie bottles up their feelings after not making the fearleading team and causes unintended electrical outbursts.

videos.title: Over Bro-tective
videos.overview: After misguided efforts, Clawd learns that being a good, older brother means more than just protecting his sister.

videos.title: Horoscare
videos.overview: Conflicting predictions from a new app say a visit from Cleo's favorite influencer will either be amazing or a disaster.

videos.title: Flaunt Your Skeleton
videos.overview: Ghoulia's dream is about to come true when she must perform for a superstar alum.

videos.title: Creepover Party
videos.overview: Draculaura, Clawdeen and Frankie meet Twyla, a boogey monster, while having a sleepover in the library.

videos.title: Creature Clash
videos.overview: Frankie, fascinated by Kuma's scare-itage, does a ritual unsupervised causing trouble for all Monster High's undead students!

videos.title: Monster Movie
videos.overview: Lagoona's creative vision is ignored by other monsters as they make a movie for the Film Festival.

videos.title: Earworm
videos.overview: Frustrated at her classmates, Toralei and her band release earworms that controls everyone's thoughts.

videos.title: Spell the Beans
videos.overview: Dracula investigates a witch rumor at Monster High, leaving Draculaura to debate whether to share her secret or get caught.

videos.title: Growing Ghoulia
videos.overview: Ghoulia tries to get the top spot on Monster High's Horror Roll but unleashes a zombie invasion.

videos.title: Casketball Jinx
videos.overview: Clawdeen jinxes the casketball team and almost quits, but realizes why the sport is important to her.

videos.title: Cleo in the Kitchen
videos.overview: Cleo tries to make a homecooked meal to raise Clawdeen's spirits and cure her homesickness.

videos.title: The Case of the Missing Squeak
videos.overview: Ghoulia helps Lagoona find her precious, secret toy, inspecting all of their classmates for the culprit.

videos.title: Pet Problems
videos.overview: Cleo gets a new pet, Hissette, and asks Deuce, snake expert, for advice which makes Frankie uneasy.

videos.title: License to Rock
videos.overview: Finnegan battles his own self-doubt and a giant kraken in order to become the next bandleader.

videos.title: Power Heist
videos.overview: When Catarina Stripe (Toralei's mom) visits Monster High, Clawdeen is stunned when Catarina proposes a monstrous trade: Clawdeen's Moon Claw for Selena Wolf's old diary.

videos.title: Monster Midterms
videos.overview: It's time for midterms at Monster High. When Clawdeen is stuck on an impossible mission with the Were-pack, she must learn from her mom's legacy to lead very different monsters.

videos.title: Fur-mergency
videos.overview: Watzie and Count Fabulous accidentally stumble into the human world and must work together to make it home undiscovered

videos.title: Boogey Nightmare
videos.overview: Twyla must complete a rite of passage by pursuing a Night Terror through her friends' dreams.

videos.title: Best Fiends
videos.overview: Draculaura and Toralei are magically stuck together on Ghoul Spirit Day while Clawdeen and Frankie track down a Codex for help.

videos.title: Scareer Day
videos.overview: On Scareer Day, Heath and his dad Hades must work together to save the school from a swarm of vicious pixies.

videos.title: Stone Alone
videos.overview: Deuce prepares for a trip, but his twin sisters try to scare him out of the idea, thinking he can't be independent.

videos.title: Horsin' Around
videos.overview: Clawd must evade Bloodgood's horse, Nightmare, to catch the Blood Thirsty Bandit who's been stealing talismans.

videos.title: Moonlit Fieldtrip
videos.overview: When Barkimedes and Howleen ask Clawdeen to show them the human world, Clawdeen battles her insecurity that humanity is boring.

videos.title: A Little Boost
videos.overview: Lagoona tries to impress Gil by getting help from Frankie, but quickly turns into an out-of-control whirlwind.

videos.title: Fresh Waters Run Deep
videos.overview: As Gil trains for the Deep Waters Challenge, he realizes that Lagoona is actually the right monster for the job.

videos.title: Sew Fierce
videos.overview: Skelita learns to honor her abuela her own way for a fashion competition.

videos.title: Witchful Thinking
videos.overview: Draculaura desperately searches for her "unique witchy power" in order to attend a special witchcraft camp

videos.title: Monster Match
videos.overview: Frankie needs to find a cool way to ask Cleo to the Monster Ball before Deuce asks her first.

videos.title: The Monster Way
videos.overview: Clawdeen leads the monster representatives in the Blood Moon Eclipse ceremony to bring her mom back. It's up to her, Draculaura, Frankie and the rest of the boo crew to save the Monster Ball - and the world.

videos.title: Rule School
videos.overview: Clawdeen finds that balancing school with her new role as Were-Ruler is way more challenging than she thought, as she faces her first big task as Were-Ruler, Clawdeen makes a decision that will shake up the were-world.

videos.title: New Witch in Town
videos.overview: When Draculaura learns that Skelita is also practicing witchcraft, she eagerly shows Skelita the "right way" to be a witch.

videos.title: Play It Again, Clawd
videos.overview: Clawd wants to spend a monster holiday, Friday the 13th, with Selena, but a time loop interferes with his plans.

videos.title: Mummy in the Mirror
videos.overview: Wanting to gain more followers, Cleo makes a deal with an ancient mirror that tries to take over her life.

videos.title: How to Scare a Banshee
videos.overview: Clawd and Draculaura fiercely compete to see who can scare Mrs. O'Shriek first and restore her lost banshee scream.

videos.title: So Chill
videos.overview: Determined to stay "chill", Abbey bottles up her feelings and accidentally freezes her friends.

videos.title: Mixed Up Meowlody
videos.overview: As Meowlody and Purrsephone prepare to play a Hissfits show, Meowlody must learn that her unique skills are a strength, not a weakness.

videos.title: The Haunted Sand Castle Caper
videos.overview: The Boo Crew vacations to the Bermuda Triangle while Dracula considers which Were-Ruler to endorse. Clawdeen investigates a destroyed sandcastle that could change the course of the election and discovers surprises on the island.

videos.title: Fangs for the Memories
videos.overview: When Draculaura and Heath find themselves in an alternate dimension where they're seven years old, Draculaura must confort her past.

videos.title: Two-riffic
videos.overview: Torn between spending time with the Boo Crew or her new friend Venus, Clawdeen decides to magically split into two.

videos.title: Monster High-jinks
videos.overview: Toralei struggles without her mom on Family Day at Monster High, so the school itself devises a way to protect her.

videos.title: Vamps Just Wanna Have Fun
videos.overview: Draculaura and her mom suppress their competitive nature during game night, but holding back causes its own problems.

videos.title: The Babysitters Crypt
videos.overview: When Cleo and Nefera babysit unruly werewolf twins, Nefera must accept that she can learn from her younger sister.

videos.title: Humans in High School
videos.overview: When Barkimedes includes Buddy in a human-themed game at Monster High, Buddy realizes the game is entirely wrong about humans.

videos.title: Dawn of the Dread
videos.overview: When Ghoulia's anxiety manifests as a monster, she hurries to get rid of it before and appointment with the school counselor.

videos.title: Frankie Patrol
videos.overview: Victor and Mary, worried for Frankie's safety, secretly reprogram their teenage child's latest robot invention for protection at all costs.

videos.title: The Deuce Date
videos.overview: Convinced that Deuce is lonely, Lagoona and Heath set him up for an ultra-romantic Heartbeast Night to lift his spirits.

videos.title: Big Paw, Little Paw
videos.overview: Toralei attempts to mentor a rowdy young werecat, but she soon realizes that she may be teaching her Little Paw the wrong lesson.

videos.title: Ghoulishly Ghoulma
videos.overview: When Spectra's Ghoulma announces that she's retiring to Sarasotaaagh, Spectra sabotages their family haunt to get her to stay.

videos.title: Gil to the Rescue
videos.overview: Inspired by his comic books, Gil takes on a superhero persona at school, but the power quickly goes to his head.

videos.title: Oh Rats
videos.overview: Deuce wants to show off his pet rat, Perseus, at the Pet Scare, but when Perseus won't participate, Deuce finds a destructive replacement.

videos.title: Fired Up
videos.overview: Jealous of Jinafire, Heath tries to outdo her climate activism with a superior Climate Science project.

videos.title: The Shapeshiftian Candidate
videos.overview: Clawdeen organizes a "Get Out to Vote" concert with Catty Noir, but a shapeshifter threatens to ruin the event. Stuck in an alternate dimension, Clawdeen and Romulus must work together to get back to Monster High before the concert.

videos.title: Codex Come Back
videos.overview: After offending the Codex by mistake and causing him to run away, Draculaura resorts to witchcraft to fix their friendship.

videos.title: Officially Complicated
videos.overview: Lagoona must work up the courage to be honest with her ghostly ex-boyfriend when he comes back into her life to haunt her.

videos.title: Little Smoothie Shop of Horrors
videos.overview: Wanting to be more of a "boss monster" like Nefera, Venus overworks herself and gets in over her head by refusing help.

videos.title: The Great Bat Detective
videos.overview: Bunny Earickson searches for a special pollinating bat in order to locate a companion plant for a wilting Venus.

videos.title: You've Got Meow
videos.overview: When an anonymous monster praises Toralei's poetry online, she's determined to find out who's behind the account.

videos.title: Finnegan Faces the Music
videos.overview: Finnegan's excited to earn a magical trident upgrade, but he scrambles to fix things when his trident breaks instead.

videos.title: The Monster Fest - Part 1
videos.overview: As Head Haunter of the Monster Fest, Frankie frets over the best way to run the festival and considers handing the reins over to Hades. Monsters start to disappear, leading Frankie to investigate when Hades sponsors the festival.

videos.title: The Monster Fest - Part 2
videos.overview: Frankie, Phoenix, and Heath search Hades' Underworld factory for their missing friends and discover a surprising culprit. The Boo Crew must "weave their own webs" and battle a foe to save the festival.

videos.title: Attack of the Besties
videos.overview: When kaiju besties Modirah and Gakaiju have a falling out, Deuce is determined to play peacemaker and fix their friendship.

videos.title: Night of the Unliving Frog
videos.overview: Manny grows attached to an adorable undead frog during a class project and is unwilling to de-animate it.

videos.title: One Were to Rule Them All
videos.overview: On the night before the election, Clawdeen confronts the shapeshifter and realizes that Headmistress Bloodgood is in danger. The Boo Crew must unite to expose the shapeshifter's true identity and ensure that the election goes off without a hitch!
